Gets the alert details including the impacted department, locations and geolocation as well as th...
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/alerts/:alert_id

Gets the alert details including the impacted department, locations and geolocation as well as the alert trigger.

​
PATH PARAMETERS

string
REQUIRED
